details.description:
Introducing the new MUNCH Choco Fills Breakfast Cereal, where your favourite MUNCH experience gets an exciting twist! This delightful cereal combines the classic crunchy exterior you love with an indulgent, melty chocolate filling inside, creating a treat that's both satisfying and fun. Each bite offers the perfect balance of textures, with the satisfying crunch giving way to a rich chocolate centre that melts in your mouth.
Crunchy outside, melty inside – MUNCH Choco Fills Breakfast Cereal brings double the fun to your mornings! Each bite combines a crispy shell with a rich, chocolatey filling, making breakfast a deliciously exciting start to your day.
Whether you're enjoying it as a breakfast staple or a tasty snack any time of the day, MUNCH Choco Fills promises double the fun and flavour. Packed with the goodness you expect from MUNCH, this cereal is perfect for chocolate lovers of all ages. Elevate your mornings and turn every moment into a joyful experience with this irresistible combination of crunch and chocolatey delight.

details.storageInstructions:
Store in a cool, dry and hygienic place. After opening, transfer the contents to an airtight container. Use within 3 weeks of opening for the best eating experience. Prolonged storage and exposure to air may result in infestation.
Directions for Use
Take 30 g of Nestlé Munch Choco Loops in a bowl.
Pour 120 ml of warm or cold milk.
Add fresh fruits of your choice.
Mix and enjoy a crunchy breakfast.
